value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Re-review round 2 (auto) blocked PR #60 with two findings, both verified valid: (blocking) the automation fixture passes the npm shim path to a Node subprocess, which cannot execute on a Windows checkout because npm installs platform shims there; (non-blocking) the ownership oracle pins the /pull/ URL rejection only for the github_url field, so a declaration-regex change could silently drop the same rejection for description declarations. General rules: (1) pm CLI invocations from Node tests must target the package JavaScript entrypoint, never the npm shim directory, whether passed as a Node argument or spawned as a command without a shell; (2) every ownership field that can carry a GitHub URL needs an adversarial pull-request rejection case in the oracle. Package-wide audit found thirteen shim invocations across eleven test files plus two packed-consumer shim commands; all will be fixed, with a source-scan property test that fails if any instance returns. Self-review also ports the sibling round's quoting-style YAML read and delivered-fixture assertion for the same test file so the next review is clean. No thresholds, pins or existing tests are weakened.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round-2 fixes complete. Thread PRRT_kwDOVOym8861cNqF (blocking): every pm CLI invocation now targets the package JavaScript entrypoint instead of the npm shim directory - 13 execPath-argument instances across ten test files plus 2 packed-consumer command instances in the install acceptance; a new source-scan property test (test/pm-entrypoint.test.ts) scans every test and script source with a must-refuse corpus (path-segment and join-part spellings) and a must-allow corpus (bind calls, PATH construction, package-manager args), so ANY re-introduced instance fails. Thread PRRT_kwDOVOym8861cNqQ (non-blocking): the ownership oracle now rejects pull-request URLs in BOTH declaration forms (GitHub issue and imported GH issue) for every number in the verified snapshot, pinning the must-identify-an-issue rejection against silent regex changes. Self-review also ported the sibling round's quoting-style YAML read of post-import-script (the regex fell back to the default for single-quoted or unquoted values) and the delivered-fixture changelog assertion. Disposable-copy revert proofs, each restored byte-identical and re-passed: (1) restoring only the npm shim on one line makes the new property test fail naming that file, the fixed line passes; (2) narrowing the declaration regex to issue URLs only, the exact silent-drop change the thread describes, makes the oracle fail at the new pull-declaration case with Missing expected exception, while the pre-round test suite passed with that mutation; (3) reverting the YAML read to the regex extraction fails the quoting-style test on single-quoted and unquoted values; (4) making the fixture item open, so generation silently omits it while the byte check still passes, fails the new Synthetic delivered change assertion while the old heading-only assertion passed. Focused gates: 101 tests pass across every changed test file (7+42+28+24), packed npm and Bun consumers plus both global-symlink repair layouts pass 4/4, typecheck, lint, duplication (0 percent, threshold 0) and docstring gates pass. No existing test, threshold or dependency pin was weakened.

The Ubuntu-only CI shell step uses its Unix launcher correctly; it is outside the faulty Node/subprocess invocation class.
